parsed_json.up: Select assay ChEMBL ID, target type, tax ID, canonical SMILES, molecule ChEMBL ID, standard type, and pChEMBL value for IC50 activities against human single-protein target CHEMBL1255129 (Proto-oncogene Wnt-1). Filter to exact standard relation '=' rows with non-null pChEMBL values. Join activities to assays, target_dictionary, molecule_dictionary, and compound_structures. Order by molecule ChEMBL ID then assay ChEMBL ID. Return the first 1000 rows without deduplication.
